verdict.rationale: AWS publishes machine-readable Smithy models "for all public AWS API services", and these models drive the daily releases of its SDKs and CLIs. There are also per-service API reference pages, such as Cost Explorer's API Reference, and an llms.txt index of service documentation. Together this strongly suggests uniform reference coverage beyond the flagship services, but no evidence directly shows that human-readable API/CLI reference docs are complete and consistent for every service. missing for 10: explicit evidence that every service has a complete API and CLI reference page, independent or hands-on corroboration of consistency across non-flagship services, a single platform-wide reference format (the models are Smithy/botocore JSON rather than OpenAPI, and versioning is documented per service).

support.subject: As a developer, every service has a real reference — consistent API/CLI reference docs across the platform, not just the flagship services

citations.quote: for all public AWS API services
